DML.SELECT: SELECT audit_log_id as "id", log_type_id as "logTypeId", log_subtype_id as "logSubtypeId", user_id as "userId", log_level_id as "levelId", time_stamp as "time", management_area_ids as "managementAreaIds", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM rt.audit_logs WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.audit_logs (audit_log_id, log_type_id, log_subtype_id, user_id, log_level_id, time_stamp, management_area_ids, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id, :logTypeId, :logSubtypeId, :userId, :levelId, :time, :managementAreaIds, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE rt.audit_logs SET user_id = :userId, log_level_id = :level, time_stamp = :time, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE audit_log_id = :id
